limitations: not a flight-correlated estimator or MEKF/Kalman filter
StarTracker has no optical star catalog, star centroiding or FOV occultation model
Sun/Earth vector measurements are ideal project-native geometry sensors; CSS remains scalar irradiance telemetry
IMU is a measured rate input, not a full strapdown navigation solution

comm_power_model.tx_enable_condition: PDU_Comm_enabled && linkActive && attemptedDataRate > 0 && antennaState in {TX,RXTX} && P_Tx > 0
limitations: constant TX-mode draw while an RF attempt is active
does not model RF PA efficiency, output-power control or rate-dependent DC draw
antenna P_Tx remains the RF link-budget transmit power, not a DC bus measurement
mechanical-work power model; not a winding resistance or bus-voltage circuit model
does not calculate copper loss, inverter switching loss or motor current dynamics
base power and conversion efficiency remain explicit engineering assumptions
